notes.title: Into The Dread is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I've released my new game recently!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054960/Into_The_Dread/]Into the Dread[/url] is a survival horror game inspired by the PSX era. You decided that exploring an abandoned sewer would be fun. Of course, something went wrong, and you were trapped in it.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Setting inspired by PSX era.
[*]Survival Horror inspired by iconic games.
[*]Solve puzzles to progress through the story.
[*]Bloody and abandoned environment.
[*]A variety of firearms.
[*]Enemy design inspired by nightmares.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054960/Into_The_Dread/

notes.title: Hotfix #3 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've received more feedback on the game, so several bugs have beed fixed!

[h2]FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug with throwing away garbage bags. Now you can't collect garbage bag while holding another one.
[*]Fixed bug with player clipping to fridge door.
[/list]

[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Now you need to eat only one product to continue your other tasks. 
[*] To get secret achievement "YUMMY" you still need to[spoiler]eat everything in the fridge[/spoiler].
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback, please let me know if you face more bugs!

notes.title: Hotfix #2 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've received more feedback on the game, so several crucial bugs that were making game unplayable are fixed now!

[h3]I would reccomend to delete both save file locations:[/h3]
[list]
[*]C:\Users\USER_NAME\AppData\LocalLow\D.B PRODUCTIONS
[*]C:\Users\USER_NAME\AppData\LocalLow\D_B PRODUCTIONS
[/list]

[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed when the UI for garbage task showed in the main menu.
[*]Fixed when the player couldn't take all 5 garbage bags.
[*]Fixed bug related to crouch system, it shouldn't be in final release build.
[*]Fixed save system, now you can choose the chapter from the main menu, previously it created a lot of problems with variables.
[*]Now some sounds Quieter/Louder.
[*]Some localization fixes.
[/list]

Please leave more feedback if you face more bugs!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is out!
notes.notes:

[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
